rules: Implement only what this issue asks, in src/text.mjs, and add unit tests under test/. Do not modify test/required-gate.test.mjs or the package.json scripts.

issues.title: Add slugify(text) to src/text.mjs
issues.summary: Add an exported function `slugify(text)` to `src/text.mjs` that turns a title into a URL slug.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-002: Every run of characters other than ASCII letters and digits becomes one `-`, and the result has no leading or trailing `-`: `slugify('  Hello,   World!  ')` returns `'hello-world'`
AC-004: `npm test` passes, including new unit tests for `slugify` under `test/`

issues.title: Add countWords(text) to src/text.mjs
issues.summary: Add an exported function `countWords(text)` to `src/text.mjs` that counts the whitespace-separated words of a text.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-003: `npm test` passes, including new unit tests for `countWords` under `test/`
